deployments_detail.use: "S-Mind" AI shopping-pattern personalization (since 2017, upgrading to hyper-personalization w/ SNU); OpenAI AI-commerce partnership; AI shopping agents

SSG.com AI shopping stack: deep-learning-based personalized product recommendation and search, plus a 24-hour AI voicebot for customer consultation. Reported 5x sales-linkage rate from recommendations and ~15% reduction in average consultation time via the voicebot. [SSG.com in-house AI]
deployments_detail.value: 5x sales-linkage rate; ~15% shorter average consultation time

deployments_detail.use: E-mart enhanced 'e-Sori' AI system to analyze ~240,000 monthly customer complaints/feedback (~8,000/day), classify by category, detect patterns, and generate store-specific operational improvement recommendations across checkout, parking, facilities, product location, and out-of-stock management. [Emart (e-Sori)]

Sparos AI demand forecasting at Emart24 convenience stores: self-developed ML platform factoring weather, location, events, day-of-week, and season to auto-generate orders, cutting ordering time from over 1 hour to ~5 minutes. Operational across 13 stores with plans to expand to 15-20. [Shinsegae I&C (Sparos AI)]
deployments_detail.value: ordering time reduced from 1+ hour to ~5 minutes; 13 stores live

deployments_detail.use: SSG.com GPT-powered product review summarization: AI applies proprietary NLP (NER + topic modeling) to classify reviews by attributes (taste, freshness, price), then GPT generates concise summaries. Launched as Korea's first e-commerce GPT review summary; available on 85% of top 1,000 food products at launch. [OpenAI GPT + SSG.com in-house NLP]
deployments_detail.value: 85% of top 1,000 food products covered at launch

deployments_detail.use: SSG.com AI Review Analysis System that analyzes ~2.5 million customer reviews per month, converting qualitative feedback into numeric scores across granular attribute criteria to inform product satisfaction and sales strategy. Built over 9 months by SSG.com's AI team and quality management team. [SSG.com in-house AI]

Shinsegae I&C 'Sparos AI Vision' deep-learning computer-vision platform powering unmanned/smart stores and 'AI checkout' that recognizes products in ~1 second without barcode scanning; trained on tens of millions of data points from its own unmanned stores. Deployed and being commercialized as a modular retail-tech solution. [Shinsegae I&C (Sparos AI Vision)]

Shinsegae Group MOU with OpenAI to build ChatGPT-based end-to-end 'AI commerce' on E-Mart by 2027, including a ChatGPT shopping agent integrated into the Emart app for search, recommendation, and purchase. Partnership was subsequently scrapped ~11 days after signing. [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]

Shinsegae Group partnership with Reflection AI to apply AI across retail operations (product sourcing, inventory management, customer management, personalized service, product curation/payment agents) and to build a 250MW sovereign AI data center on NVIDIA GPUs. [Reflection AI, NVIDIA]

Shinsegae Department Store 'AI Ready Data' personalization framework, co-developed with Seoul National University's Graduate School of Data Science; research accepted as an ICML paper. Planned 'AI Sales Agent' to analyze real-time sales data for customer characteristics, purchasing patterns, and promotions, targeted for early 2027. [Shinsegae Department Store + Seoul National University]
deployments_detail.value: up to 46% higher average transaction value (simulation)

deployments_detail.use: Sparos 'ScanCare' edge-AI computer-vision solution that detects scan omissions and barcode fraud at self-checkout, running on an Intel mini-PC with NPU and IP cameras. Deployed at Emart24, Emart, and SK Hynix Icheon campus; commercialized at low cost (tens of thousands of won range) for external customers. [Shinsegae I&C (Sparos ScanCare), Intel]
deployments_detail.value: checkout/wait time 4x+ faster than traditional stores
